name: boulevard
instructions:
Boulevard Client API, the surface a business exposes on behalf of its own clients. Booking is a cart flow, not a single call: create_cart, add_service, then bookable_dates and bookable_times to find a slot, reserve_time to hold it, and checkout to turn the hold into an appointment. Every step that changes state is held behind a confirmation gate and sends nothing until the token from its preview is returned. Ask the client to confirm the previewed time, price and service before you send it.

Every operation, argument and type here was taken from Boulevard's own MIT-licensed book-sdk (github.com/Boulevard/book-sdk, src/graph.d.ts), not from guesswork. It has NOT been run against a live or sandbox tenant, because sandbox credentials are issued through the Boulevard Developer Portal to Enterprise accounts. Treat it as a reviewed design against a published schema until those credentials exist.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: The business's name, timezone, website and locations. Call this first to establish which business and timezone every later date belongs to.
tools.query: query { business { id name tz website locations(first: 25) { edges { node { id name businessName phoneNumber tz isRemote address { line1 city state zip } } } } } }

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Paginated list of the business's locations. Use when the business has more locations than get_business returned.
tools.query: query($first: Int, $after: String) { locations(first: $first, after: $after) { edges { cursor node { id name businessName phoneNumber tz address { line1 city state zip } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read a cart, including the services available to book on it and what is currently selected. This is how you discover a location's bookable services and their ids.
tools.query: query($cart_id: ID!) { cart(id: $cart_id) { id location { id name tz } availableCategories { id name availableItems { id name description ... on CartAvailableBookableItem { listPrice listDuration } } } selectedItems { id ... on CartBookableItem { item { id name } selectedStaffVariant { id staff { id firstName lastName } duration price } } } summary { total subtotal taxAmount gratuityAmount } } }

tools.name: bookable_dates
tools.description: Which dates have any availability for what is currently in the cart. Call this before bookable_times: it narrows a month to a handful of days in one request instead of thirty.

params.name: tz
params.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to the location's.

tools.query: query($cart_id: ID!, $searchRangeLower: Date, $searchRangeUpper: Date, $tz: Tz, $limit: Int) { cartBookableDates(id: $cart_id, searchRangeLower: $searchRangeLower, searchRangeUpper: $searchRangeUpper, tz: $tz, limit: $limit) { date } }

tools.name: bookable_times
tools.description: The bookable start times on one date. Each returned id is the bookableTimeId that reserve_time and reschedule_appointment take.
tools.query: query($cart_id: ID!, $searchDate: Date!, $tz: Tz) { cartBookableTimes(id: $cart_id, searchDate: $searchDate, tz: $tz) { id startTime score } }

tools.name: bookable_staff
tools.description: Which staff can perform a selected service at a given time, with their price and duration. Use when the client asks for a specific provider.

params.name: itemId
params.description: Id of the selected cart item, not the service id

tools.query: query($cart_id: ID!, $bookableTimeId: ID!, $itemId: ID!) { cartBookableStaffVariants(id: $cart_id, bookableTimeId: $bookableTimeId, itemId: $itemId) { id duration price staff { id firstName lastName } } }

tools.name: my_appointments
tools.description: The authenticated client's appointments. Requires a client token in BLVD_CLIENT_TOKEN; without one this returns nothing rather than another client's data.
tools.query: query($first: Int, $after: String) { myAppointments(first: $first, after: $after) { edges { node { id startAt endAt duration cancelled state appointmentServices { id service { name } staff { firstName lastName } } location { id name } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

tools.name: get_appointment
tools.description: One appointment in full, including its services, staff, state and cancellation if there is one.

params.name: cartId
params.description: Cart the appointment was booked from, if reading it before the client is authenticated

tools.query: query($appointment_id: ID!, $cartId: ID) { appointment(id: $appointment_id, cartId: $cartId) { id startAt endAt duration cancelled state clientId appointmentServices { id service { name } staff { firstName lastName } } location { id name tz } cancellation { reason } } }

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Start a booking at a location. Returns the cart id every later step needs. Creates no appointment and charges nothing on its own.

params.name: locationId
params.description: Location to book at. Omit for a single-location business.

params.name: clientMessage
params.description: Note from the client to the business

tools.query: mutation($locationId: ID, $clientMessage: String, $referralSource: String) { createCart(input: {locationId: $locationId, clientMessage: $clientMessage, referralSource: $referralSource}) { cart { id location { id name tz } } } }

tools.name: add_service
tools.description: Add a bookable service to the cart. itemId is the availableItems id from get_cart, not the name of the service.

params.name: itemStaffVariantId
params.description: Specific provider. Omit to let Boulevard choose.

tools.query: mutation($cart_id: ID!, $itemId: ID!, $itemStaffVariantId: ID, $itemOptionIds: [ID!]) { addCartSelectedBookableItem(input: {id: $cart_id, itemId: $itemId, itemStaffVariantId: $itemStaffVariantId, itemOptionIds: $itemOptionIds}) { cart { id selectedItems { id } summary { total } } } }

tools.name: reserve_time
tools.description: Hold a slot from bookable_times. The hold is temporary and expires; it is not a booking until checkout succeeds.
tools.query: mutation($cart_id: ID!, $bookableTimeId: ID!) { reserveCartBookableItems(input: {id: $cart_id, bookableTimeId: $bookableTimeId}) { cart { id startTime } } }

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Turn the held cart into a real appointment. This is the step that books the client and can take payment. Show the client the previewed total and time and get an explicit yes before returning the confirmation token.
tools.query: mutation($cart_id: ID!) { checkoutCart(input: {id: $cart_id}) { appointments { id startAt endAt } cart { id summary { total } } } }

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel a booked appointment. This frees the slot, may trigger the business's cancellation policy and fee, and cannot be undone from here.
tools.query: mutation($appointment_id: ID!, $notes: String) { cancelAppointment(input: {id: $appointment_id, notes: $notes}) { appointment { id cancelled } } }

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a different bookable time.

params.name: sendNotification
params.description: Whether the client is notified of the change

tools.query: mutation($appointmentId: ID!, $bookableTimeId: ID!, $sendNotification: Boolean!) { appointmentReschedule(input: {appointmentId: $appointmentId, bookableTimeId: $bookableTimeId, sendNotification: $sendNotification}) { appointment { id startAt endAt } } }
